verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणेन तु तद्वाक्यमुक्तं श्रुत्वा स राघवः ।सन्दधे परवीरघ्नो धनुरादाय वीर्यवान् ।रावणाय शरान् घोरान् विससर्ज चमूमुखे ।। ६.१०३.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇena tu tadvākyamuktaṁ śrutvā sa rāghavaḥ ।sandadhe paravīraghno dhanurādāya vīryavān ।rāvaṇāya śarān ghorān visasarja camūmukhe ।। 6.103.1 ।।

translations.english: Courageous Raghava, the destroyer of enemies on hearing the words spoken by Lakshmana took up his bow and fixed it.

verses.sloka: अथान्यं रथमारुह्य रावणो राक्षसाधिपः ।अभ्यद्रवत काकुत्स्थं स्वर्भानुरिव भास्करम् ।। ६.१०३.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: athānyaṁ rathamāruhya rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ ।abhyadravata kākutsthaṁ svarbhānuriva bhāskaram ।। 6.103.2 ।।

translations.english: Rama discharged dreadful shafts at Ravana's army in the forefront. Ravana ascended another chariot and went towards Rama, just as the planet Rahu moved towards the Sun.
translations.hindi: उसे सुन वह लंबी साँसें ले कुछ देर .तक तो कुछ सोचता विचारता रहा ; किर क्रोध के मारे उसकी शक्ल बड़ी भयानक जान पड़ने लगी

verses.sloka: दशग्रीवो रथस्थस्तु रामं वज्रोपमैः शरैः ।आजघान महाघोरैर्धाराभिरिव तोयदः ।। ६.१०३.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: daśagrīvo rathasthastu rāmaṁ vajropamaiḥ śaraiḥ ।ājaghāna mahāghorairdhārābhiriva toyadaḥ ।। 6.103.3 ।।

translations.english: Seated in the chariot, the ten headed Ravana showered thunderbolt like shafts just as rain cloud showers on a huge mountain and struck.
translations.hindi: बह दांतों से अपने ओठ चबाने लगा ओर मारे क्रोध के उसके नेत्र लाल लाल हो गए | वह उस समय कालाग्नि की तरह ( क्रोध से ) धधक रहा था। ओर तो ओर, उसके पास जो राक्षस सदा रहते थे, उनसे भी मारे'डर के उसकी ओर नहीं निहारा जाता था

verses.sloka: दीप्तपावक सङ्काशैः शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः ।निर्बिभेद रणे रामो दशग्रीवं समाहितम् ।। ६.१०३.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: dīptapāvaka saṅkāśaiḥ śaraiḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।nirbibheda raṇe rāmo daśagrīvaṁ samāhitam ।। 6.103.4 ।।

translations.english: Sri Rama steadily covered Ravana, the ten headed Rakshasa with shining shafts covered with gold glowing like fire in the battle.
translations.hindi: राक्षसराज रावण पास खड़े इए रा्षक्षों से बोला । यद्यपि उस समय क्रोध के आवेश में होने के कारण उसके मुख से साफ स्तर बाते नहीं निकलती थी ; तथापि वह अपने नेत्रां से मानों भस्म करता हुआ सा बोला

verses.sloka: भूमौ स्थितस्य रामस्य रथस्थस्य च रक्षसः ।न समं युद्धमित्याहुर्देवगन्धर्वदानवाः ।। ६.१०३.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: bhūmau sthitasya rāmasya rathasthasya ca rakṣasaḥ ।na samaṁ yuddhamityāhurdevagandharvadānavāḥ ।। 6.103.5 ।।

translations.english: Rama standing on the earth and Ravana seated on the chariot and waging war is not fair, declared Devas, Gandharvas and Kinneras.
translations.hindi: महोदर, महापाशचं ओर विरूगच से कह दो कि, मेरी आज्ञा से वे राक्षस सेनिकों से कह दें कि, सब लोग तैयार हो कर शीघ्र . निकलें

verses.sloka: ततः काञ्चनचित्राङ्गः किङ्किणीशतभूषितः ।तरुणादित्यसङ्काशो वैडूर्यमयकूबरः ।। ६.१०३.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kāñcanacitrāṅgaḥ kiṅkiṇīśatabhūṣitaḥ ।taruṇādityasaṅkāśo vaiḍūryamayakūbaraḥ ।। 6.103.6 ।।

translations.english: The foremost of Devas, the glorious Indra, on hearing their sweet words called his charioteer Matali and spoke as follows.
translations.hindi: मूतः -अभिइृद्ः । (गो ) + पाठान्तरे ्मद्धण ˆ मूछितः--अमभिदृद्ध: । ( गो० ) # पाठान्तरे--“मया ” | घण्णनवतितस: सग: १०४७. रावण के ये वचन सुन, भयपीड़ित राक्षसों ने उसके आज्ञा- नुसार निभय राक्षस सेनिकों को शीघ्र तैयार होने के लिए कहा

verses.sloka: सदश्वैः काञ्चनापीडैर्युक्तः श्वेतप्रकीर्णकैः ।हरिभिः सूर्यसङ्काशैर्हेमजालविभूषितैः ।। ६.१०३.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sadaśvaiḥ kāñcanāpīḍairyuktaḥ śvetaprakīrṇakaiḥ ।haribhiḥ sūryasaṅkāśairhemajālavibhūṣitaiḥ ।। 6.103.7 ।।

translations.english: "Proceed quickly in my chariot to the foremost of the Raghus on the earth, where Sri Rama stands and call him to sit in the chariot as per the words of Devas."
translations.hindi: भयङ्कर राक्षस सेनिक भी “ बहुत अच्छा ” कह कर तथा विविध प्रकार के मङ्गलाचार कर, समरभूमि को ओर जाने को तैयार हुए

verses.sloka: रुक्मवेणुध्वजः श्रीमान् देवराजरथो वरः ।देवराजेन सन्दिष्टो रथमारुह्य मातलिः ।। ६.१०३.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: rukmaveṇudhvajaḥ śrīmān devarājaratho varaḥ ।devarājena sandiṣṭo rathamāruhya mātaliḥ ।। 6.103.8 ।।

translations.english: Lord of Devas having spoken that way, the charioteer of Devas offering salutations to Devas in obedience spoke these words.
translations.hindi: फिर डन निशाचरों ने रावण के पास जा, यथाविधि उसका पूजन किआ ओर उसका विजय मता, वे सत्र हाथ जोड़ कर, उसके सामने खड़े हो गए

verses.sloka: अभ्यवर्तत काकुत्स्थमवतीर्य त्रिविष्टपात् ।। ६.१०३.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: abhyavartata kākutsthamavatīrya triviṣṭapāt ।। 6.103.9 ।।

translations.english: "O Devendra, I will do the duty of charioteer duly to the Lord of gods with green horses proceeding quickly", said the charioteer."

verses.sloka: अब्रवीच्च तदा रामं सप्रतोदो रथे स्थितः ।प्राञ्जलिर्मातलिर्वाक्यं सहस्राक्षस्य सारथिः ।। ६.१०३.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: abravīcca tadā rāmaṁ sapratodo rathe sthitaḥ ।prāñjalirmātalirvākyaṁ sahasrākṣasya sārathiḥ ।। 6.103.10 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Matali brought the glorious chariot of Lord of Devas. It was decked with charming gold wheels, body fitted with hundreds of gold bells that shone like the early morning sun, decked with gold on top, green horses with white whisks shining like the Sun, decked with golden net, the horses yoked to staff, and the flag fitted on golden bamboo staff. Descending from the chariot, like from heaven, Matali went towards Kakuthsa.

verses.sloka: सहस्राक्षेण काकुत्स्थ रथो ऽयं विजयाय ते ।दत्तस्तव महासत्त्व श्रीमान् शत्रुनिबर्हण ।। ६.१०३.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: sahasrākṣeṇa kākutstha ratho 'yaṁ vijayāya te ।dattastava mahāsattva śrīmān śatrunibarhaṇa ।। 6.103.11 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Matali brought the glorious chariot of Lord of Devas. It was decked with charming gold wheels, body fitted with hundreds of gold bells that shone like the early morning sun, decked with gold on top, green horses with white whisks shining like the Sun, decked with golden net, the horses yoked to staff, and the flag fitted on golden bamboo staff. Descending from the chariot, like from heaven, Matali went towards Kakuthsa.

verses.sloka: इदमैन्द्रं महच्चापं कवचं चाग्निसन्निभम् ।शराश्चादित्यसङ्काशाः शक्तिश्च विमला शिता ।। ६.१०३.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: idamaindraṁ mahaccāpaṁ kavacaṁ cāgnisannibham ।śarāścādityasaṅkāśāḥ śaktiśca vimalā śitā ।। 6.103.12 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Matali brought the glorious chariot of Lord of Devas. It was decked with charming gold wheels, body fitted with hundreds of gold bells that shone like the early morning sun, decked with gold on top, green horses with white whisks shining like the Sun, decked with golden net, the horses yoked to staff, and the flag fitted on golden bamboo staff. Descending from the chariot, like from heaven, Matali went towards Kakuthsa.
translations.hindi: नैवान्तरिक्षं न दिशो न नद्या नापि सागराः । प्रकाशत्वं गमिष्यन्ति मद्वाणजलदाट्टृताः ॥ १२ मेरे छोड़े हुए बाणरूपी बादलों से आकाश, दिशाएँ, नदियाँ और सागर ढक जाँयगे और दिखलाई न पड़ेंगे

verses.sloka: आरुह्येमं रथं वीर राक्षसं जहि रावणम् ।मया सारथिना राजन् महेन्द्र इव दानवान् ।। ६.१०३.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: āruhyemaṁ rathaṁ vīra rākṣasaṁ jahi rāvaṇam ।mayā sārathinā rājan mahendra iva dānavān ।। 6.103.13 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Matali brought the glorious chariot of Lord of Devas. It was decked with charming gold wheels, body fitted with hundreds of gold bells that shone like the early morning sun, decked with gold on top, green horses with white whisks shining like the Sun, decked with golden net, the horses yoked to staff, and the flag fitted on golden bamboo staff. Descending from the chariot, like from heaven, Matali went towards Kakuthsa.

verses.sloka: इत्युक्तः सम्परिक्रम्य रथं समभिवाद्य च ।आरुरोह तदा रामो लोकान् लक्ष्म्या विराजयन् ।। ६.१०३.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityuktaḥ samparikramya rathaṁ samabhivādya ca ।āruroha tadā rāmo lokān lakṣmyā virājayan ।। 6.103.14 ।।

translations.english: Then the thousand eyed charioteer, holding the whip in hand, from the chariot, offered salutations with folded palms to Sri Rama and spoke these words.
translations.hindi: आज्ञ पवन के समान वेग से चलने वाले रथ पर सवार हो, -घनुषरूपी समुद्र से उत्पन्न हुई, बाण्रूपी लहरों द्वारा वानरी सेना -झो मथ डाल्ँगा

verses.sloka: तद्बभूवाद्भुतं युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् ।रामस्य च महाबाहो रावणस्य च रक्षसः ।। ६.१०३.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadbabhūvādbhutaṁ yuddhaṁ tumulaṁ romaharṣaṇam ।rāmasya ca mahābāho rāvaṇasya ca rakṣasaḥ ।। 6.103.15 ।।

translations.english: "To you, Kakuthsa, who are endowed with great prowess, destroyer of enemies, this chariot has been sent by Indra for your victory."

verses.sloka: स गान्धर्वेण गान्धर्वं दैवं दैवेन राघवः ।अस्त्रं राक्षसराजस्य जघान परमास्त्रवित् ।। ६.१०३.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa gāndharveṇa gāndharvaṁ daivaṁ daivena rāghavaḥ ।astraṁ rākṣasarājasya jaghāna paramāstravit ।। 6.103.16 ।।

translations.english: "Here is Indra's mighty bow, armour shining like fire, shafts resembling the Sun and stainless auspicious javelin."
translations.hindi: समरभूमि में आज वानरी सेना के यूथपति मेरे बाणं से बिघे हुए अपने झखों से उनाल ( डंडी सहित ) कमलपुष्प की तरह भूमि को भूषित करेंगे

verses.sloka: अस्त्रं तु परमं घोरं राक्षसं राक्षसाधिपः ।ससर्ज परमक्रुद्धः पुनरेव निशाचरः ।। ६.१०३.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: astraṁ tu paramaṁ ghoraṁ rākṣasaṁ rākṣasādhipaḥ ।sasarja paramakruddhaḥ punareva niśācaraḥ ।। 6.103.17 ।।

translations.english: "O heroic king! With me as charioteer, mounting this chariot, kill the Rakshasa Ravana as Mahendra killed the demons."
translations.hindi: युद्ध करने में प्रचण्ड और पेड़ रूरी आयुधों से लड़ने वाले सो सो वानरों को में एक एक बाण से वेध डालूँगा

verses.sloka: ते रावणधनुर्मुक्ताः शराः काञ्चनभूषणाः ।अभ्यवर्तन्त काकुत्स्थं सर्पा भूत्वा महाविषाः ।। ६.१०३.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: te rāvaṇadhanurmuktāḥ śarāḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇāḥ ।abhyavartanta kākutsthaṁ sarpā bhūtvā mahāviṣāḥ ।। 6.103.18 ।।

translations.english: Speaking like that, Matali went round Sri Rama, and went round the chariot clockwise saluting him. Sri Rama then ascended the chariot, illuminating his splendour to the world.
translations.hindi: जिन राक्षसियों के पति और पुत्र युद्ध में मारे गए हैं, आज उनके शत्रु को मार कर, में उनके आँसुओं को पोंछू गा

verses.sloka: ते दीप्तवदना दीप्तं वमन्तो ज्वलनं मुखैः ।राममेवाभ्यवर्तन्त व्यादितास्या भयानकाः ।। ६.१०३.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: te dīptavadanā dīptaṁ vamanto jvalanaṁ mukhaiḥ ।rāmamevābhyavartanta vyāditāsyā bhayānakāḥ ।। 6.103.19 ।।

translations.english: Then a wonderful, severe thrilling fight took place between Sri Rama and Ravana.

verses.sloka: तैर्वासुकिसमस्पर्शैर्दीप्तभोगैर्महाविषैः ।दिशश्च सन्तताः सर्वाः प्रदिशश्च समावृताः ।। ६.१०३.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: tairvāsukisamasparśairdīptabhogairmahāviṣaiḥ ।diśaśca santatāḥ sarvāḥ pradiśaśca samāvṛtāḥ ।। 6.103.20 ।।

translations.english: Raghava who was highly skilled in the use of supreme weapons destroyed that missile presided over by Gandharvas and gods, released by Ravana.
translations.hindi: आज श्गाल, गिद्ध तथा अन्य जो माँसभक्ती पशु पक्षी हैं, उन सबको बाणों से मारे हुए शत्रुओं के माँस से अघा दू गा

verses.sloka: तान् दृष्ट्वा पन्नगान् रामः समापतत आहवे ।अस्त्रं गारुत्मतं घोरं प्रादुश्चके भयावहम् ।। ६.१०३.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tān dṛṣṭvā pannagān rāmaḥ samāpatata āhave ।astraṁ gārutmataṁ ghoraṁ prāduścake bhayāvaham ।। 6.103.21 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasa king, the night ranger, became highly furious and once again discharged the most terrific missile presided over by Rakshasas.
translations.hindi: अब शीघ्र मेरा रथ तैयार करो ओर तुरन्त भेरा धनुष ले आओ । जो राक्षस बचे हुए हैं, दे सब मेरे पीछे पीछे चलें

verses.sloka: ते राघवशरा मुक्ता रुक्मपुङ्खाः शिखिप्रभाः ।सुपर्णाः काञ्चना भूत्वा विचेरुः सर्पशत्रवः ।। ६.१०३.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: te rāghavaśarā muktā rukmapuṅkhāḥ śikhiprabhāḥ ।suparṇāḥ kāñcanā bhūtvā viceruḥ sarpaśatravaḥ ।। 6.103.22 ।।

translations.english: The shafts released from Ravana's bow were covered with gold and highly venomous like serpents reached near Kakuthsa.
translations.hindi: रावण की इन बातों को सुन, सहापाश्व ने वहाँ उपस्थित सेना- पतियों से कहा--सेना को शीघ्र तैयार होने को कहो

verses.sloka: ते तान् सर्वान् शरान् जघ्नुः सर्परूपान् महाजवान् ।सुपर्णरूपा रामस्य विशिखाः कामरूपिणः ।। ६.१०३.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: te tān sarvān śarān jaghnuḥ sarparūpān mahājavān ।suparṇarūpā rāmasya viśikhāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ।। 6.103.23 ।।

translations.english: Those shafts with wide flaming mouths, vomiting fire, glowing, frightening, and striking went over to Rama.
translations.hindi: उन फुर्तीले सेनापतियों ने सारी लङ्कापुरी में घूम फिर कर ओर क्रोध में भर ( इसलिए कि बहुत से राक्षस डर के मारे बुलाने पर भी घर से नहीं निकलते थे ) घर घर में जा कर और राक्षसं को राजाज्ञा सुना कर शीघ्र तैयार हो कर निकलने को कहा

verses.sloka: अस्त्रे प्रतिहते क्रुद्धो रावणो राक्षसाधिपः ।अभ्यवर्षत्तदा रामं घोराभिः शरवृष्टिभिः ।। ६.१०३.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: astre pratihate kruddho rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ ।abhyavarṣattadā rāmaṁ ghorābhiḥ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ ।। 6.103.24 ।।

translations.english: Flaming coils like the Vasuki, covering all quarters with poison, enveloped all over.

verses.sloka: ततः शरसहस्रेण राममक्लिष्टकारिणम् ।अर्दयित्वा शरौघेण मातलिं प्रत्यविध्यत ।। ६.१०३.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śarasahasreṇa rāmamakliṣṭakāriṇam ।ardayitvā śaraugheṇa mātaliṁ pratyavidhyata ।। 6.103.25 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the dreadful reptiles approaching, Rama discharged the missile presided over by Garuda.
translations.hindi: तलवारों, पटो, शूलो, गदाओं, मूसलों, दुधारा खाडों, पेनी धारी वाली शक्तियों, कॉटेदार मुगदरों, लोहे के डंडों, चमचमाते चक्रां, पेने पेने परश्वधों, भिन्दिपालो :( गदा बिशेष), शतध्नियों तथा अन्य श्रेष्ठ श्रेष्ठ आयुधो से युद्ध करने वाले राक्षस योद्धाओं- को

verses.sloka: चिच्छेद केतुमुद्धिश्य शरेणैकेन रावणः ।पातयित्वा रथोपस्थे रथात् केतुं च काञ्चनम् ।ऐन्द्रानपि जघानाश्वान् शरजालेन रावणः ।। ६.१०३.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: ciccheda ketumuddhiśya śareṇaikena rāvaṇaḥ ।pātayitvā rathopasthe rathāt ketuṁ ca kāñcanam ।aindrānapi jaghānāśvān śarajālena rāvaṇaḥ ।। 6.103.26 ।।

translations.english: By the missile discharged by Raghava those reptiles and snakes turned into golden feathered eagles and by the shine of the feathers, the reptiles flew.
translations.hindi: , ततः प्रयातः सहसा राक्षसेबहुमिह्तः । रावणः सत्त्वगाम्भीर्याहारयन्निव मेदिनीम्‌ ॥२&॥ क ` तर १ हुलेः-द्विफलपत्राग्रायुघविशेषैः । ( गो० ) २ सत्वगाम्मीर्यात्‌-- बलातिशयात्‌ । ( गो० ) १०४५२ युद्धकाण्डे तदनन्तर बहुत से राक्षसां को साथ लिए हुए रावण अपने महाबल से भूमि को विदीण करता हुआ चला

verses.sloka: तं दृष्ट्वा सुमहत्कर्म रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ।विषेदुर्देवगन्धर्वा दानवाश्चारणैः सह ।। ६.१०३.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ dṛṣṭvā sumahatkarma rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ ।viṣedurdevagandharvā dānavāścāraṇaiḥ saha ।। 6.103.27 ।।

translations.english: Those shafts of Rama in the form of eagles which could change their form at will, destroyed the serpent forms and they flew at great speed.

verses.sloka: राममार्तं तदा दृष्ट्वा सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः ।व्यथिता वानरेन्द्राश्च बभूवुः सविभीषणाः ।। ६.१०३.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāmamārtaṁ tadā dṛṣṭvā siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ ।vyathitā vānarendrāśca babhūvuḥ savibhīṣaṇāḥ ।। 6.103.28 ।।

translations.english: King of Rakshasas knocked back, became enraged and covered Rama with a terrific shower of shafts.
translations.hindi: आठ घोड़े जुते हुए सारथी सहित रथ पर भयङ्कर रावण तुरन्त सवार हुआ । वह रथ अपनी चमक से दमक रहा था

verses.sloka: रामचन्द्रमसं दृष्ट्वा ग्रस्तं रावणराहुणा ।प्राजापत्यं च नक्षत्रं रोहिणीं शशिनः प्रियाम् ।। ६.१०३.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāmacandramasaṁ dṛṣṭvā grastaṁ rāvaṇarāhuṇā ।prājāpatyaṁ ca nakṣatraṁ rohiṇīṁ śaśinaḥ priyām ।। 6.103.29 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter having showered a thousand shafts on Rama, of unwearied action, Ravana pierced Matali with shafts.

verses.sloka: समाक्रम्य बुधस्तस्थौ प्रजानामशुभावहः ।। ६.१०३.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: samākramya budhastasthau prajānāmaśubhāvahaḥ ।। 6.103.30 ।।

translations.english: Ravana attacked the flag post of the chariot with one arrow and felled it down. Then he released a network of arrows on Indra's horses and struck them.

verses.sloka: सधूमपरिवृत्तोर्मिः प्रज्वलन्निव सागरः ।उत्पपात तदा क्रुद्धः स्पृशन्निव दिवाकरम् ।। ६.१०३.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sadhūmaparivṛttormiḥ prajvalanniva sāgaraḥ ।utpapāta tadā kruddhaḥ spṛśanniva divākaram ।। 6.103.31 ।।

translations.english: On seeing Sri Rama afflicted by the action of evilminded Ravana, the Devas, Gandharvas, Charanas, Danavas also, Siddhas and foremost rishis were despondent. Seeing the moon like Sri Rama eclipsed by planet Rahu in the form of Ravana, the Vanara leaders and Vibheeshana became worried.
translations.hindi: वे सब के सब इषित हो ऐसे गरज रहे थे, मानों भूमि को विदीर्ण कर डालेंगे । वे सड अयङ्कर सिंहनाद करते हुए जयप्राप्ति की आकांक्षा रखे हुए लंका से निकले

verses.sloka: शस्त्रवर्णः सुपरुषो मन्दरश्मिर्दिवाकरः ।अदृश्यत कबन्धाङ्कः संसक्तो धूमकेतुना ।। ६.१०३.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: śastravarṇaḥ suparuṣo mandaraśmirdivākaraḥ ।adṛśyata kabandhāṅkaḥ saṁsakto dhūmaketunā ।। 6.103.32 ।।

translations.english: On seeing Sri Rama afflicted by the action of evilminded Ravana, the Devas, Gandharvas, Charanas, Danavas also, Siddhas and foremost rishis were despondent. Seeing the moon like Sri Rama eclipsed by planet Rahu in the form of Ravana, the Vanara leaders and Vibheeshana became worried.
translations.hindi: सबभूतक्षयकारी कालान्तक यमराज की तरह तेजस्वी रावण राक्षसों की सेना साथ लिये संथा हाथ में रोदा चढा चढाया ५ तैयार ) धनुष लिए हुए निकला.

verses.sloka: कोसलानां च नक्षत्रं व्यक्तमिन्द्राग्निदैवतम् ।आक्रम्याङ्गारकस्तस्थौ विशाखामपि चाम्बरे ।। ६.१०३.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: kosalānāṁ ca nakṣatraṁ vyaktamindrāgnidaivatam ।ākramyāṅgārakastasthau viśākhāmapi cāmbare ।। 6.103.33 ।।

translations.english: When the planet Budha comes closer to the Rohini planet presided over by the Lord of creation, people predict bad luck.

verses.sloka: दशास्यो विंशतिभुजः प्रगृहीतशरासनः ।अदृश्यत दशग्रीवो मैनाक इव पर्वतः ।। ६.१०३.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: daśāsyo viṁśatibhujaḥ pragṛhītaśarāsanaḥ ।adṛśyata daśagrīvo maināka iva parvataḥ ।। 6.103.34 ।।

translations.english: The waves of the ocean were, as if in fury, waves covered with mist turning around as though to touch the radiant sun rose high.
translations.hindi: उस समय सूर्य का प्रकाश मंद पड़ गया | दिशाओं में अन्धः कार छा गया । पक्षोगण भयंकर बोलियाँ बोलने लगे । परथिवी काँप उठी

verses.sloka: निरस्यमानो रामस्तु दशग्रीवेण रक्षसा ।नाशक्नोदभिसन्धातुं सायकान् रणमूर्धनि ।। ६.१०३.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: nirasyamāno rāmastu daśagrīveṇa rakṣasā ।nāśaknodabhisandhātuṁ sāyakān raṇamūrdhani ।। 6.103.35 ।।

translations.english: The Sun seemed without radiance like the colour of weapon (grey), in the form of Kabhanda (headless trunk), combined with Dhumakethu.

verses.sloka: स कृत्वा भ्रुकुटिं क्रुद्धः किञ्चित् संरक्तलोचनः ।जगाम सुमहाक्रोधं निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा ।। ६.१०३.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa kṛtvā bhrukuṭiṁ kruddhaḥ kiñcit saṁraktalocanaḥ ।jagāma sumahākrodhaṁ nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā ।। 6.103.36 ।।

translations.english: In the sky, the planet Mars too stood in constellation with Visakha star presided over by gods Indra and Agni in heaven, which was propitious for the kosala kings.
translations.hindi: रावण की बाँधी आँख और बाँयी भुजा फड़कने लगी । उसके' चेहरे का रंग फीका पड़ गया ओर कण्ठस्वर सी कुछ कुछ बिगड़ गया

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे त्र्युत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। १०३ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe tryuttaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 103 ।।

translations.english: Ravana with ten heads and twenty arms seizing his bow appeared like the Mynaka mountain.
translations.hindi: दशग्रीव रावण को इस युद्धयात्रा के समय बे समस्त असगुन देख पढ़े जो उसका युद्ध में मारा जाना प्रकट कर रहे थे
